item.title: Tariffs, diesel and computer chips are driving up costs for automakers
item.description: American auto companies say they are paying more for key components like computer chips, steel and copper — plus the fuel needed to transport their products.

item.title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
item.description: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
item.description: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.

item.title: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
item.description: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

item.title: Netflix lays off 6% of workforce amidst slowing growth
item.description: Netflix is regrouping after the release of its latest quarterly earnings this week. Revenue growth at the streaming giant has slowed as the company works to overhaul its programming unit.
